decisions.reason: Door lever handle families in architectural hardware have long lifecycles, and two years on the market is too early for withdrawal, especially since weaker launches were already pruned in 2024.
The mitred handle family fills a distinct design niche within the coordinated range, and its tooling investment favours continued sales.
The award-winning FSB 1289 collection has its own page and serves as a flagship, so keeping it is clearly warranted.
The light patinated bronze finish uses in-house finishing expertise across many models at low upkeep cost and supports the sustainable premium-material positioning.
